scope.ja: 既存のL安定2段SDIRK2でy′=−1000(y−cos t)−sin t、y(0)=1をt=1まで解く。解析解、固定刻み細分化、別の強減衰1段問題を検査。
scope.en: Use the existing two-stage L-stable SDIRK2 for y'=-1000(y-cos(t))-sin(t), y(0)=1 up to t=1. Check its analytic solution, fixed-step refinement and a separate very stiff one-step decay.

assumptions.ja: rate=1000、1000/2000/4000ステップでrate*h=1,0.5,0.25。固定γ=1−1/√2と既存Newton段階解法を使用。別の減衰はy′=−10⁸y、y(0)=1、h=1。適応刻み法ではない。
assumptions.en: rate=1000; 1000/2000/4000 steps give rate*h=1,0.5,0.25. Uses fixed gamma=1-1/sqrt(2) and the existing Newton stage solver. Separate decay: y'=-1e8*y, y(0)=1, h=1. No adaptive stepping.

units.ja: 無次元時間と状態。rateの次元は逆時間、rate*hは無次元。
units.en: Dimensionless time/state; rate has inverse-time units and rate*h is dimensionless.

boundaries.ja: 初期値問題で空間境界なし。終端時刻を必ず含む等間隔列。
boundaries.en: Initial-value problem with no spatial boundaries; an equal-step sequence includes the final time.

description.ja: CSVは最細刻みの数値解・解析解・絶対誤差。観測次数は全時刻最大誤差から計算。旧保存例の粗格子で約1台になる挙動と、今回の解像した刻みでの次数を混同しない。
description.en: CSV contains finest-grid time, numerical/analytic state and absolute error. Orders use maximum-in-time errors. Distinguish the older coarse-step order reduction from the resolved refinement here.

description.ja: 解析解y=cos t+(y₀−1)e^(−rate*t)。別の同次減衰も指数関数を参照。
description.en: Analytic y=cos(t)+(y0-1)*exp(-rate*t); the separate homogeneous decay also uses an exponential reference.

description.ja: 既存SDIRK2項目にあるDIRKの原論文。選んだ係数・Newton設定は公開実装に固定。
description.en: DIRK paper already cited by the SDIRK2 record; selected coefficients/Newton settings are fixed by the released implementation.

failure_scope.ja: 方式違い、非有限入力、非正の率や刻み数、倍増でない列を拒否。Newton段階失敗は例外のまま伝える。粗い硬い刻みで一律2次収束を主張せず、今回の細分化で測定する。L安定でも正値を厳密に保つとは限らない。一般DAE・硬いPDEの検証ではない。
failure_scope.en: Reject other methods, nonfinite inputs, nonpositive rates/counts and non-doubling levels. Propagate implicit-stage failures. Do not claim uniform second order on coarse stiff steps; measure this supplied refinement. L-stability does not imply exact positivity. Not validation of general DAEs or stiff PDEs.

reference_notes.ja: CSVは最細刻みの数値解・解析解・絶対誤差。観測次数は全時刻最大誤差から計算。旧保存例の粗格子で約1台になる挙動と、今回の解像した刻みでの次数を混同しない。
reference_notes.en: CSV contains finest-grid time, numerical/analytic state and absolute error. Orders use maximum-in-time errors. Distinguish the older coarse-step order reduction from the resolved refinement here.

scope.ja: 自作コードはMIT。入力・数値データ・図・本文はサイトの個別条件に従います。この台帳は利用許諾を拡大しません。
scope.en: Original code is MIT. Inputs, numerical data, figures and prose retain the site’s item-specific terms. This registry does not expand reuse permissions.

description.ja: 細かい固定刻みの全時刻で解析解と比較。
description.en: Compare the finest fixed-step trajectory with the analytic solution at all times.

description.ja: 指定した細分化で観測次数を調べる。硬い粗格子で一律2次とは仮定しない。
description.en: Check observed order on the supplied refinement; do not assume uniform second order on coarse stiff steps.

description.ja: この初期値の余弦追従解が有界。
description.en: Bounded cosine tracking for this supplied initial condition.

description.ja: 別の強減衰1段問題を解析的指数減衰と比較。
description.en: Compare a separate very stiff one-step decay with analytic exponential decay.

description.ja: 指定した終端時刻に到達。

description.en: SHA-256 of the executed fixed input

description.ja: 入力に記載した条件の合格
description.en: Acceptance conditions in the input passed

outcome.ja: 硬い余弦追従問題の解析解と刻み細分化を比べ、別の強減衰問題でL安定な応答を確認する。
outcome.en: Compare stiff cosine tracking with its analytic solution under step refinement, plus a separate strongly damped problem.

latex: y'=-1000(y-\cos t)-\sin t,\qquad y(0)=1,\qquad y_{\rm ref}(t)=\cos t

note.ja: 既存2段SDIRK2を使う時間初期値問題。主問題はt=1、1000/2000/4000刻み。46モデル台帳とは別の実行例の式で、熱PDEや汎用硬い系の新規モデルとして数えない。
note.en: Temporal initial-value problems using the existing two-stage SDIRK2. Main case: t=1 and 1000/2000/4000 steps. These example formulas are separate from the 46-model inventory, not new heat-PDE or general stiff-system entries.
